async def refresh_file_node_beacons(
    self,
    file_node_id: str,
    *,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    cancel_callback: Callable[[], bool] | None = None,
    progress_callback: Callable[[str, int, int], None] | None = None,
    diagnostic_parent_id: str | None = None,
    source_path_override: str | None = None,
    carto_claim_id: str | None = None,
    force: bool = False,
    held_grant=None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Incremental, beacon-aware per-file refresh (F12).

    CURRENT BEHAVIOR:
    - Returns failed-source retention as structured data without updating
      the FILE note or seeding/reconciling the failed scope; partial Vue
      refreshes protect the identified failed section's existing UUIDs.
    - Builds a per-file NEXUS-style JSON (terrain/gem-like) shaped for
      ``workflowy_move_reconcile.reconcile_tree``.
    - Invokes ``reconcile_tree(...)`` with create/update/delete/move wrappers
      to apply an incremental plan for this FILE node (no full rebuild).
      Eligible sibling runs use one verified insert vector per identifiable
      subrun, selected separately so degradation between repeats stays bare
      v1; fresh-parent descendants remain sequential v1.
    - Persists the per-file ``source_json`` to ``temp/cartographer_file_refresh``
      for inspection and debugging.
    - Joins data-only facts, hierarchy, source hygiene/parse and sequential
      planning phases. Diagnostic sends remain in this task before any
      later identity-seeding failure; no client or cancel callback enters
      those workers. Ordered artifact/progress writes and the paths-only
      diagnostic sink are joined before return; task scopes reset on errors.

    If the incremental pipeline fails for any reason, the failure is raised
    with probe metadata and traceback so the owning CARTO job becomes visibly
    failed. There is no destructive full-rebuild fallback.

    ``source_path_override`` (F12+4 temporary-file regime, Dan 2026): when
    provided, ``file_node_id`` is treated as the reconcile PARENT verbatim
    and the given absolute path is used as the Cartographer source instead
    of reading a ``Path:``/``Root:`` header off the node's note. This is
    used to split an ordinary node's raw-Markdown note (already written to a
    THROWAWAY ``.md``) into a Workflowy subtree WITHOUT turning that node
    into a mapped FILE node — the case where the node lives inside an
    already-mapped Markdown file and must NOT become a nested mapped
    Markdown file. The descendant→FILE walk and the portable Path-header
    rewrite are both skipped in this mode; the caller deletes the temp file
    after the reconcile completes.
    """
    logger = _ClientLogger()
    log_event(
        f"refresh_file_node_beacons (incremental scaffold) start (file_node_id={file_node_id}, dry_run={dry_run})",
        "BEACON",
    )

    incremental_probe: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    resolved_from_descendant = False
    # Structured, non-fatal WARNINGS accumulated during this per-file
    # refresh (surfaced up through the folder result + CARTO job JSON so
    # the UUID-widget status bar shows a persistent completed_with_warnings
    # state). The dominant case: two existing Workflowy nodes in THIS file
    # subtree carry the SAME beacon id (an intra-file duplicate), which
    # makes reconcile identity-matching ambiguous and drives the endless
    # CREATE+DELETE+reorder churn. See _detect_duplicate_ether_beacon_ids.
    refresh_warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    # F12+4 TEMPORARY-FILE OVERRIDE (Dan, 2026).
    # When source_path_override is provided, the target node is NOT a
    # Cartographer FILE node and carries NO Path:/Root: note header — it is
    # an ordinary node (e.g. one living inside a mapped Markdown file) whose
    # raw-Markdown note was just written to a THROWAWAY .md on disk. We are
    # asked to split that .md into a Workflowy subtree under file_node_id.
    # In this mode we MUST NOT (a) walk up to an enclosing Path: ancestor
    # (that would refresh the WRONG file — the enclosing mapped Markdown),
    # nor (b) require/parse a Path: header on the node, nor (c) rewrite the
    # node's note to a portable Path: segment. We use the override path
    # directly and let the rest of the pipeline (map_codebase → reconcile)
    # build children under file_node_id exactly as usual.
    source_path_override = (source_path_override or "").strip() or None

    # 0) Optional descendant→FILE resolution so callers may pass a beacon or AST
    # child UUID and still get a file-scoped incremental refresh.
    # SKIPPED entirely under source_path_override (see note above): the
    # override node deliberately has no Path: header and must be treated as
    # the reconcile parent verbatim, not resolved to an enclosing FILE node.
    try:
        raw_cache = await export_nodes_impl(
            self,
            node_id=None,
            use_cache=True,
            force_refresh=False,
        )
        from ..coherence.operation_cache import current_operation_cache
        snapshot = current_operation_cache(required=False)
        if snapshot is not None and snapshot.owner is (getattr(self, "_cache_view_publisher", None) or self):
            nodes_by_id_cache = snapshot.view.nodes_by_id
        else:
            nodes_by_id_cache = await run_carto_cpu(
                "file:index", _index_carto_export_nodes, raw_cache.get("nodes", []) or [],
            )
    except Exception:
        nodes_by_id_cache = {}

    resolved_file_node_id = _resolve_carto_refresh_root(
        nodes_by_id_cache, file_node_id,
        source_regime="temp_override" if source_path_override else "standard",
        source_path_override=source_path_override,
    )
    if resolved_file_node_id != str(file_node_id):
        log_event(
            "refresh_file_node_beacons (incremental): resolved descendant UUID "
            f"{file_node_id} → FILE node {resolved_file_node_id}",
            "BEACON",
        )
        file_node_id = resolved_file_node_id
        resolved_from_descendant = True

    try:
        # 1) Export the FILE subtree to discover current structure and Path
        try:
            raw = await export_nodes_impl(self, file_node_id)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            raise NetworkError(
                f"export_nodes failed for {file_node_id} (incremental scaffold): {e}"
            ) from e

        flat_nodes = raw.get("nodes") or []
        if not flat_nodes:
            raise NetworkError(
                f"File node {file_node_id} not found or has empty subtree (incremental scaffold)",
            )

        facts = await run_carto_cpu(
            "file:facts", _prepare_carto_file_facts, flat_nodes, str(file_node_id),
            nodes_by_id_cache, source_path_override,
        )
        source_path, repo_root_abs = facts["source_path"], facts["repo_root_abs"]

        # NEW: directory-aware routing – if Path/Root points to a directory,
        # delegate to the FOLDER-level Cartographer sync instead of the
        # per-file incremental pipeline.
        if facts["is_directory"]:
            log_event(
                "refresh_file_node_beacons: Path/Root points to directory; "
                f"routing to refresh_folder_cartographer_sync for node {file_node_id}",
                "BEACON",
            )
            folder_result = await self.refresh_folder_cartographer_sync(
                folder_node_id=str(file_node_id),
                dry_run=dry_run,
                cancel_callback=cancel_callback,
                progress_callback=progress_callback,
                carto_claim_id=carto_claim_id,
                force=force,
                held_grant=held_grant,
            )
            if isinstance(folder_result, dict):
                folder_result.setdefault("routed_from", "refresh_file_node_beacons")
            return folder_result

        # Only data enters these joined phases. A diagnostic write is
        # fulfilled here before advancing into any later seeding work.
        hierarchical_tree = await run_carto_cpu("file:hierarchy", _prepare_carto_file_tree, flat_nodes)
        parsed = await run_carto_cpu(
            "file:source", _prepare_carto_source_file, source_path, repo_root_abs,
            dry_run=dry_run, claimed=carto_claim_id,
        )
        await run_carto_cpu("file:source-diagnostics", _log_carto_source_messages, parsed["messages"])
        metadata = {**facts, "file_node_id": str(file_node_id),
                    "diagnostic_parent_id": diagnostic_parent_id, "dry_run": dry_run,
                    "nodes_by_id_cache": nodes_by_id_cache, "flat_nodes": flat_nodes}
        file_plan = _plan_carto_file_refresh(parsed, hierarchical_tree, metadata)
        try:
            while True:
                done, item = await run_carto_cpu("file:plan", _advance_carto_file_plan, file_plan)
                if done:
                    break
                try:
                    if item["existing_id"]:
                        await self.update_node(item["existing_id"], NodeUpdateRequest(
                            name=item["diag_name"], note=item["diag_note"], layoutMode=None,
                        ))
                    else:
                        await self.create_node(NodeCreateRequest(
                            name=item["diag_name"], parent_id=str(diagnostic_parent_id),
                            note=item["diag_note"], layoutMode=None, position="top",
                        ), _internal_call=True)
                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                    log_event(
                        "refresh_file_node_beacons: failed to write folder-level parse-error diagnostic "
                        f"for {source_path}: {e}", "BEACON",
                    )
        finally:
            await run_carto_cpu("file:plan-close", file_plan.close)
        source_json = item["source_json"]
        pending_file_note = item["pending_file_note"]
        refresh_warnings = item["warnings"]
        prepared_data = {key: value for key, value in parsed["prepared"].items()
                         if key not in {"snapshot", "analysis_inputs", "map"}}
        projection = item["projection"]
        if source_json is None:
            return {**prepared_data, **projection, "projection": projection,
                    "success": False, "status": "failed", "dry_run": dry_run,
                    "file_node_id": str(file_node_id), "source_path": source_path,
                    "error": prepared_data.get("error") or "Source outline unavailable; existing symbols retained",
                    "header_freshness": item["header_freshness"],
                    "nodes_created": 0, "nodes_updated": 0, "nodes_deleted": 0,
                    "nodes_moved": 0, "api_calls": 0,
                    "warning_count": len(refresh_warnings)}

        # Task paths are explicit; a nonjob caller uses the ordinary default,
        # never another task's process environment. The owned source is not
        # consumed by reconcile until this exact serialization has joined.
        file_context = current_carto_job_context()
        artifact_paths = await run_carto_cpu("file:source-artifact", _write_carto_file_artifact, "source", {
            "job_dir": str(file_context.job_dir) if file_context is not None else None,
            "file_node_id": str(file_node_id), "source_path": source_path, "source_json": source_json,
        })
        source_json_path = artifact_paths["source_json_path"]

        # 7) Call reconcile_tree to compute and optionally apply an incremental
        # plan for this FILE node. This uses the same reconciliation engine as
        # WEAVE but scoped to a single file.
        from ..models import NodeListRequest
        from .workflowy_move_reconcile import reconcile_tree as _reconcile_tree_for_f12
        from .carto_reconcile_cpu import ReconcileCreateResult
        from .create_transport import PlacementIntent
        from ..coherence.transition_create import TransitionCreateTransaction
        from ..mutation_lease_governance import build_region_child_set, MutationRegionError
        from ..mutation_locks import _regions_cover_request
        from ..models import RateLimitError
        from uuid import UUID

        stats: dict[str, Any] = {
            "api_calls": 0,
            "nodes_created": 0,
            "nodes_updated": 0,
            "nodes_deleted": 0,
            "nodes_moved": 0,
        }

        # Progress belongs to this task. No process-global job-file reader.
        carto_job_file = str(file_context.job_file) if file_context is not None else None
        _carto_pending = {
            "nodes_created": 0,
            "nodes_updated": 0,
            "nodes_moved": 0,
            "nodes_deleted": 0,
        }
        _carto_ops = 0
        _carto_retry_counts: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}

        # @beacon[
        #   id=carto-progress@refresh_file_node_beacons._carto_flush_progress,
        #   role=refresh_file_node_beacons _carto_flush_progress,
        #   slice_labels=ra-carto-jobs,ra-reconcile,
        #   kind=ast,
        #   comment=Snapshots per-task apply counters on-loop and joins their atomic status merge off-loop; retains buffered increments and retry targets until acknowledged and never lets a writer outlive this task.,
        # ]
        async def _carto_flush_progress(*, force: bool = False, phase: str | None = None) -> None:
            nonlocal _carto_ops
            if not carto_job_file:
                return

            _carto_ops += 1
            # Flush on EVERY operation (Dan, 2026): the previous
            # ``_carto_ops % 10`` throttle only wrote the CARTO job JSON
            # once per 10 ops, so the widget's node counters visibly
            # ticked in jumps of 10. Because the underlying Workflowy
            # mutations are already rate-limited to ~1/sec, a local JSON
            # write per op is negligible cost and gives a smooth
            # once-per-second live counter in the widget. The
            # ``_carto_ops`` counter is retained (cheap) in case a future
            # throttle is ever reintroduced.

            # Only write if there is something to report.
            if (not force) and (not phase) and all(int(v or 0) == 0 for v in _carto_pending.values()):
                return

            result = await run_carto_cpu("file:progress", _write_carto_file_artifact, "progress", {
                "path": carto_job_file, "pending": dict(_carto_pending),
                "retry_counts": dict(_carto_retry_counts), "phase": phase,
            })
            _carto_retry_counts.update(result["retry_counts"])
            for k, v in result["acknowledged"].items():
                _carto_pending[k] -= v
                _carto_retry_counts.pop(k, None)
            context = current_carto_job_context()
            if context is not None:
                context.progress.update(result["counts"])
                if phase:
                    context.progress["current_phase"] = phase

        async def file_log(message):
            await run_carto_cpu("file:log", _write_carto_file_artifact, "log", {
                "path": artifact_paths["debug_path"], "message": message,
            })

        async def list_wrapper(parent_uuid: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
            request = NodeListRequest(parentId=parent_uuid)
            nodes, _ = await self.list_nodes(request)
            stats["api_calls"] += 1
            return await run_carto_cpu("file:list-values", _carto_list_node_values, nodes)

        active_create = None
        active_create_parent = None

        async def conclude_create_parent(parent_uuid):
            nonlocal active_create, active_create_parent
            if active_create is None or (parent_uuid is not None and parent_uuid != active_create_parent):
                return None
            transaction = active_create
            active_create = active_create_parent = None
            witness = await transaction.conclude(relist=False)
            if witness is not None:
                return ReconcileCreateResult((), (), tuple(witness.ordered_child_ids), dict(witness.priority_by_id))

        async def create_wrapper(run):
            nonlocal active_create, active_create_parent
            parent_uuid = run.parent_uuid
            region = None
            if (held_grant is not None and not run.parent_created
                    and parent_uuid in held_grant.snapshot.nodes_by_id):
                try:
                    candidate = build_region_child_set(parent_uuid, cache_by_id=held_grant.snapshot.nodes_by_id)
                    if _regions_cover_request(held_grant.regions, (candidate,),
                                              cache_by_id=held_grant.snapshot.nodes_by_id):
                        region = candidate
                except MutationRegionError:
                    # Unrepresentable coverage is unavailable acceleration,
                    # not a new refusal of the existing refresh.
                    pass
            try:
                usable_predecessor = str(UUID(run.predecessor_uuid)) == run.predecessor_uuid
            except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
                usable_predecessor = False
            identifiers, physical = [], []
            witness = None
            outcome, debt = "v1_boundary", False

            def result_data():
                return ReconcileCreateResult(tuple(identifiers), tuple(physical),
                    tuple(witness.ordered_child_ids) if witness is not None else (),
                    dict(witness.priority_by_id) if witness is not None else {}, debt, outcome)

            async def account(nodes):
                for node in nodes:
                    identifiers.append(node.id)
                    stats["api_calls"] += 1
                    stats["nodes_created"] += 1
                    if not dry_run:
                        _carto_pending["nodes_created"] += 1
                if not dry_run:
                    try:
                        await _carto_flush_progress(phase="apply_reconcile")
                    except BaseException as error:
                        error.reconcile_create_result = result_data()
                        raise

            def retain_prefix(error):
                nonlocal witness
                prefix = active_create.verified_prefix
                witness = active_create._latest
                physical.extend("after" for _ in prefix)
                # No await here: preserve the original failure even when
                # progress reporting would observe cancellation again.
                for node in prefix:
                    identifiers.append(node.id)
                    stats["nodes_created"] += 1
                    stats["api_calls"] += 1
                    if not dry_run:
                        _carto_pending["nodes_created"] += 1
                if identifiers:
                    error.reconcile_create_result = result_data()

            requests = []
            for data in run.items:
                explicit_top = data.get("_position_hint") == "top"
                position = "top" if explicit_top or (region is not None and run.placement == "top") else "bottom"
                req = NodeCreateRequest(name=data.get("name"), parent_id=parent_uuid,
                    note=data.get("note"), layoutMode=(data.get("data") or {}).get("layoutMode"), position=position)
                requests.append(req)
                await file_log(f"F12 CREATE: {data.get('name')}")
                if not dry_run:
                    try:
                        await _carto_flush_progress(force=True, phase=f"create:{data.get('name')}")
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            # Identity boundaries are shared with Layer C; select anew before
            # every subrun so unavailability never buys a verification GET.
            for group in TransitionCreateTransaction.identifiable_runs(self, requests):
                requests = list(group)
                previous_count = len(identifiers)
                selection = (self._insert_capability.select_for_insert()
                    if region is not None and run.placement == "after" and usable_predecessor
                    and all(req.layoutMode in (None, "bullets") for req in requests) else None)
                if selection is not None and selection.transport == "llm":
                    try:
                        if active_create_parent != parent_uuid:
                            await conclude_create_parent(None)
                            active_create = TransitionCreateTransaction(self, parent_uuid, held_grant, parent_region=region)
                            active_create_parent = parent_uuid
                    except BaseException:
                        self._insert_capability.record_neutral(selection)
                        raise
                    placement = PlacementIntent.after(identifiers[-1] if identifiers else run.predecessor_uuid)
                    resent_prefix = None
                    while True:
                        try:
                            verified = await active_create.create_many(requests, placement, selection=selection)
                        except RateLimitError as error:
                            if not (getattr(error, "llm_endpoint_429", False)
                                    and getattr(error, "llm_dispatch_started", False)):
                                retain_prefix(error)
                                raise
                            # A repeated-fingerprint subrun may already be
                            # verified. Never resend that current-call prefix.
                            prefix = active_create.verified_prefix
                            if prefix:
                                witness = active_create._latest
                                physical.extend("after" for _ in prefix)
                                await account(prefix)
                                requests = requests[len(prefix):]
                                placement = PlacementIntent.after(prefix[-1].id)
                            if resent_prefix != len(identifiers):
                                resent_prefix = len(identifiers)
                                selection = self._insert_capability.select_for_insert()
                                if selection.transport == "llm":
                                    continue
                            await conclude_create_parent(parent_uuid)
                            break
                        except BaseException as error:
                            retain_prefix(error)
                            raise
                        else:
                            witness = verified.order_witness
                            physical.extend(verified.transport == "llm" and "after" or "bottom"
                                            for _ in verified.created_nodes)
                            debt = debt or verified.reorder_required
                            outcome = "llm_committed" if verified.transport == "llm" else "llm_absent_then_v1"
                            await account(verified.created_nodes)
                            break
                    if len(identifiers) > previous_count:
                        continue
                # Unavailable/no-grant/boundary work is today's bare v1,
                # without a transaction baseline or mandatory-list surcharge.
                await conclude_create_parent(parent_uuid)
                if not identifiers:
                    witness = None
                for req in requests:
                    try:
                        node = await self.create_node(req, _internal_call=True, fetch_created_node=False)
                    except BaseException as error:
                        if identifiers:
                            error.reconcile_create_result = result_data()
                        raise
                    physical.append(req.position)
                    debt = debt or run.placement == "after"
                    outcome = "v1_order_debt" if debt else "v1_boundary"
                    await account((node,))
            return result_data()

        async def update_wrapper(node_uuid: str, data: dict) -> None:
            # Pass-through to update_node which is the single point of
            # NAME/NOTE encoding via encode_for_workflowy_api.
            req = NodeUpdateRequest(
                name=data.get("name"),
                note=data.get("note"),
                layoutMode=(data.get("data") or {}).get("layoutMode"),
            )
            await file_log(f"F12 UPDATE: {node_uuid}")
            await self.update_node(node_uuid, req)
            stats["api_calls"] += 1
            stats["nodes_updated"] += 1
            if not dry_run:
                _carto_pending["nodes_updated"] += 1
                await _carto_flush_progress(phase="apply_reconcile")

        async def delete_wrapper(node_uuid: str) -> None:
            await file_log(f"F12 DELETE: {node_uuid}")
            await self.delete_node(node_uuid)
            stats["api_calls"] += 1
            stats["nodes_deleted"] += 1
            if not dry_run:
                _carto_pending["nodes_deleted"] += 1
                await _carto_flush_progress(phase="apply_reconcile")

        async def move_wrapper(node_uuid: str, new_parent: str, position: str = "top") -> None:
            await file_log(f"F12 MOVE: {node_uuid}")
            await self.move_node(node_uuid, new_parent, position)
            stats["api_calls"] += 1
            stats["nodes_moved"] += 1
            if not dry_run:
                _carto_pending["nodes_moved"] += 1
                await _carto_flush_progress(phase="apply_reconcile")

        async def export_wrapper(node_uuid: str) -> dict:
            # Use the same bulk export helper as the rest of the client.
            await file_log(f"F12 EXPORT: {node_uuid}")
            data = await export_nodes_impl(self, node_uuid)
            stats["api_calls"] += 1
            return data

        # FILE-NOTE HEADER FRESHNESS (Dan 2026): the ONE note-only header
        # update for an ordinary eligible FILE — performed before the child
        # reconcile, through the governed update path (encoding + governor
        # + cache mutation via self.update_node), so api_calls,
        # nodes_updated and CARTO progress reflect it. Guards:
        # - dry_run never writes;
        # - a requested cancellation skips the write (no write after a
        #   cancellation request; the reconcile's own cancel checks take
        #   over from here);
        # - a failed write raises through the normal per-file failure path
        #   (a failed header update is a failed, retryable refresh — never
        #   a swallowed error with stale metadata);
        # - an unchanged merged header (second refresh, no growth) writes
        #   NOTHING (pending_file_note stays None).
        if pending_file_note is not None and not dry_run:
            _cancel_requested = False
            if cancel_callback is not None:
                try:
                    _cancel_requested = bool(cancel_callback())
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    _cancel_requested = False
            if _cancel_requested:
                log_event(
                    "refresh_file_node_beacons: cancellation requested; FILE header update skipped "
                    f"(file_node_id={file_node_id})",
                    "BEACON",
                )
            else:
                log_event(
                    "refresh_file_node_beacons: FILE header freshness update "
                    f"(file_node_id={file_node_id})",
                    "BEACON",
                )
                await update_wrapper(str(file_node_id), {"note": pending_file_note})

        # 7) Execute incremental reconcile_tree with per-file journal + debug log
        # Set tag-specific debug log context so reconcile_debug.log is written
        # next to the per-file source_json when available.
        weave_scope = weave_log_scope(source_json_path or _current_weave_context.get())
        f12_journal_path: str | None = None
        log_weave_entry_fn: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], None] | None = None

        if not dry_run and source_json_path:
            f12_journal_path = await run_carto_cpu("file:journal-open", _write_carto_file_artifact,
                                                  "journal-open", {"source_json_path": source_json_path})

            # @beacon[
            #   id=weave-journal@refresh_file_node_beacons.log_weave_entry_fn,
            #   role=refresh_file_node_beacons.log_weave_entry_fn,
            #   slice_labels=ra-logging,ra-reconcile,ra-carto-jobs,ra-bulk-visible-apply,
            #   kind=ast,
            #   comment=Retains the synchronous best-effort journal callback only for nonjob callers; real daemon FILE work installs a paths-only CartoDiagnosticSink and joins each ordered diagnostic batch off-loop under its own task and grant.,
            # ]
            def log_weave_entry_fn(entry: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
                if f12_journal_path is None:
                    return
                _write_carto_file_artifact("journal-entry", {"path": f12_journal_path, "entry": entry})

        from pathlib import Path
        from .carto_reconcile_cpu import CartoDiagnosticSink
        previous_sink = file_context.diagnostic_sink if file_context is not None else None
        if file_context is not None:
            file_context.diagnostic_sink = CartoDiagnosticSink(
                debug_path=Path(artifact_paths["debug_path"]),
                journal_path=Path(f12_journal_path) if f12_journal_path else None,
            )
        weave_scope.__enter__()
        try:

            # @beacon[
            #   id=carto-cancel@refresh_file_node_beacons.reconcile_tree_cancel_callback,
            #   role=refresh_file_node_beacons passes cancel_callback into reconcile_tree,
            #   slice_labels=ra-carto-jobs,ra-reconcile,
            #   kind=span,
            # ]
            # U5 guard 2b (spec [ap:HFYAG2] §6): arm reconcile_tree's
            # dormant delete threshold on this one live call site.  A
            # truncated/accidentally-blanked source file would otherwise
            # delete the FILE node's whole symbol subtree; the threshold
            # aborts the reconcile before its DELETE phase unless this run
            # carries an explicit per-run force.  Config read follows the
            # established try/except-default idiom — a config failure
            # falls back to the GovernanceConfiguration model defaults so
            # the guard never fails open.
            try:
                _reconcile_governance = get_server_config().governance
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                from ..models.config import (
                    GovernanceConfiguration as _GovernanceConfiguration,
                )

                _reconcile_governance = _GovernanceConfiguration()
            _reconcile_delete_threshold = int(
                _reconcile_governance.carto_reconcile_delete_threshold
            )
            reconcile_result = await _reconcile_tree_for_f12(
                source_json=source_json,
                parent_uuid=str(file_node_id),
                list_nodes=list_wrapper,
                create_node=create_wrapper,
                conclude_create_parent=conclude_create_parent,
                update_node=update_wrapper,
                delete_node=delete_wrapper,
                move_node=move_wrapper,
                export_nodes=export_wrapper,
                import_policy="strict",
                dry_run=dry_run,
                max_delete_threshold=_reconcile_delete_threshold,
                force=force,
                skip_delete_bulk_export_wait=True,
                log_weave_entry=log_weave_entry_fn,
                log_to_file_msg=lambda m: _log_to_file_helper(m, "reconcile"),
                allow_pure_reorder=True,
                cancel_callback=cancel_callback,
                cancel_check_interval=10,
            )
            # @beacon-close[
            #   id=carto-cancel@refresh_file_node_beacons.reconcile_tree_cancel_callback,
            # ]
            if f12_journal_path:
                await run_carto_cpu("file:journal-finish", _write_carto_file_artifact, "journal-finish", {
                    "path": f12_journal_path, "completed": True,
                })
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            if f12_journal_path:
                await run_carto_cpu("file:journal-finish", _write_carto_file_artifact, "journal-finish", {
                    "path": f12_journal_path, "completed": False, "error": str(e),
                })
            await file_log(f"refresh_file_node_beacons incremental: reconcile_tree failed: {e}")
            raise
        finally:
            weave_scope.__exit__(None, None, None)
            if file_context is not None:
                file_context.diagnostic_sink = previous_sink

        incremental_probe = {
            "success": True,
            "source_json_file": source_json_path,
            "reconcile_result": reconcile_result,
            "file_node_id_effective": str(file_node_id),
            "source_path": source_path,
            "resolved_from_descendant": resolved_from_descendant,
            "stats": stats,
        }
        log_event(
            "refresh_file_node_beacons incremental scaffold complete "
            f"(file_node_id_effective={file_node_id}, source_json_file={source_json_path}, dry_run={dry_run})",
            "BEACON",
        )

    except (APIResponseError, OperationCancelledError) as e:
        # A permanent API 4xx or explicit CARTO cancellation is not an
        # incremental-algorithm failure. No alternate rebuild path can heal
        # it; propagate immediately so the owning daemon task finalizes.
        log_event(
            "refresh_file_node_beacons incremental path stopped without fallback "
            f"(file_node_id_effective={file_node_id}): {e}",
            "BEACON",
        )
        raise

    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        import traceback

        tb = traceback.format_exc()
        # Fail loud. Preserve the complete probe and traceback on the raised
        # error so the owning daemon task records actionable diagnostics.
        incremental_probe = {
            "success": False,
            "error": str(e),
            "file_node_id_effective": str(file_node_id),
            "resolved_from_descendant": resolved_from_descendant,
            "traceback": tb,
        }
        _log_to_file_helper(
            "refresh_file_node_beacons incremental scaffold failed; no fallback exists: "
            f"{e}\n{tb}",
            "reconcile",
        )
        log_event(
            "refresh_file_node_beacons incremental scaffold failed; raising job failure "
            f"(file_node_id_effective={file_node_id}): {e}",
            "BEACON",
        )
        raise NetworkError(
            "Incremental Cartographer reconciliation failed; no legacy fallback exists",
            details=incremental_probe,
        ) from e

    # 8) The only successful terminal path returns the incremental result.
    if incremental_probe is not None and incremental_probe.get("success"):
        result: dict[str, Any] = {
            **prepared_data,
            **projection,
            "projection": projection,
            "status": "partial_section" if projection["state"] == "partial_section" else "refreshed",
            "success": True,
            "file_node_id": incremental_probe.get("file_node_id_effective"),
            "source_path": incremental_probe.get("source_path"),
            "dry_run": dry_run,
            "reconcile_result": incremental_probe.get("reconcile_result"),
        }
        stats = incremental_probe.get("stats")
        if isinstance(stats, dict):
            result["changed"] = bool(prepared_data.get("changed") or
                                     any(stats.get(key) for key in
                                         ("nodes_created", "nodes_updated", "nodes_deleted", "nodes_moved")))
            result.update(
                {
                    "nodes_created": stats.get("nodes_created"),
                    "nodes_updated": stats.get("nodes_updated"),
                    "nodes_deleted": stats.get("nodes_deleted"),
                    "nodes_moved": stats.get("nodes_moved"),
                    "api_calls": stats.get("api_calls"),
                }
            )

        # Surface any non-fatal warnings (e.g. intra-file duplicate beacon
        # ids) so the folder aggregator + terminal adapter can escalate the
        # CARTO job to completed_with_warnings for the widget status bar.
        if refresh_warnings:
            result["warnings"] = refresh_warnings
            result["warning_count"] = len(refresh_warnings)

        result["_incremental_probe"] = incremental_probe
        if not dry_run:
            try:
                self._mark_nodes_export_dirty(
                    [str(incremental_probe.get("file_node_id_effective") or file_node_id)]
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
        return result

    raise NetworkError(
        "Incremental Cartographer reconciliation ended without a success result",
        details=incremental_probe,
    )

_carto_terminal_payload_data.source:
def _carto_terminal_payload_data(metadata, result, outcome):
    """Carry the whole structured outcome; retain legacy fallback and typed errors."""
    exception = metadata["exception"]
    stopped = metadata["stopped"]
    result = dict(result) if isinstance(result, Mapping) else {}
    errors = result.get("refresh_errors") or result.get("errors") or (result.get("result_summary") or {}).get("errors")
    summary = dict(outcome.get("result_summary") or result.get("result_summary") or result)
    structured = isinstance(summary.get("files"), list) and "successful" in summary
    if structured and (exception is not None or stopped):
        from .beacon_refresh_support import beacon_job_outcome
        summary = beacon_job_outcome(summary, infrastructure_error=exception, cancelled=stopped)
    returned_failure = exception is None and ((summary.get("success") is False or summary.get("status") == "failed")
                                              if structured else (result.get("success") is False or result.get("status") == "failed" or errors))
    if returned_failure:
        exception = {"type": "RuntimeError", "text": str(result.get("error") or errors or "Cartographer work returned failure"),
                     "kind": "scheduling_failed" if metadata["scheduling_failed"] else "carto_job_exception",
                     "extra": {}, "coherence_prefix": False}
        if result.get("error_kind"):
            exception.update(kind=result["error_kind"], extra=result.get("error_extra") or result.get("coherence_admission") or {})
    warnings = summary.get("warnings") or result.get("warnings") or []
    status = ("cancelled" if stopped else "failed" if exception is not None else
              str((summary.get("status") if structured else outcome.get("status")) or ("completed_with_warnings" if warnings or result.get("completed_with_warnings") else "completed")))
    extra = {"job_id": metadata["job_id"], "phase": metadata["phase"],
             "may_have_workflowy_effects": metadata["may_have_workflowy_effects"]}
    payload = {"id": metadata["job_id"], "type": metadata["job_type"], "mode": metadata["mode"],
               "root_uuid": metadata["root_uuid"], "claim_id": metadata["claim_id"],
               "execution_model": "daemon_task", "execution_owner": "launcher",
               "detached": False, "pid": metadata["pid"], "status": status,
               "updated_at": metadata["updated_at"],
               "cache_refresh_required": metadata["may_have_workflowy_effects"],
               "result_summary": summary, "warnings": warnings,
               "warning_count": summary.get("warnings_total", len(warnings)),
               "error": outcome.get("error")}
    if exception is not None and not stopped:
        extra["exception_type"] = exception["type"]
        kind = exception["kind"]
        extra = {**exception["extra"], **extra}
        payload.update(error_kind=kind, error_extra=extra, error=(
            f"Cartographer job {metadata['job_id']} failed during {metadata['phase']}: {exception['type']}: {exception['text']}. "
            "The daemon is still serving; inspect the job result before retrying."
        ) if kind in {"carto_job_exception", "scheduling_failed"} else
            f"coherence_barrier_active: {exception['text']}" if exception["coherence_prefix"] else exception["text"])
    if metadata["restart_observed"]:
        payload["result_summary"]["message"] = (
            "Stopped at a safe job boundary for daemon restart; completed work is retained. Re-run the job if needed."
        )
    return payload
